decks.notes: This aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, while also putting pressure on them with efficient creatures like Flickerwisp and Emperor of Bones. The deck also includes cards like Ephemerate and Solitude for additional disruption and removal, as well as strong finishers like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd. By combining disruption and aggressive creatures, this deck aims to control the game and close out the match quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game using counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Narset. By keeping the opponent's threats in check and disrupting their game plan, the deck aims to maintain control of the board until it can establish a dominating position and win the game. The inclusion of the companion Kaheera adds an additional threat and synergizes well with the deck's creature spells. Overall, this UW Control deck is designed to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent in a battle of wits and strategy.

The concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan and control the game through counter spells and removal. The deck focuses on using cards like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Counterspell to deal with threats while maintaining card advantage with cards like Thought Scour and Psychic Frog. The deck also utilizes creatures like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus to apply pressure while still being able to control the board. The mana base is built to support the control strategy with dual lands and fetch lands to ensure consistent mana production.

The deck aims to quickly reanimate powerful creatures like Griselbrand while controlling the game with various instant spells and disruption like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's plans while setting up a game-winning play. The deck thrives on being able to surprise the opponent with fast plays and overwhelming them with powerful creatures and control elements.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through various spells and counter abilities, as well as utilizing powerful creatures like Murktide Regent to dominate the board. The deck focuses on disruption, removal, and card advantage to outmaneuver the opponent and maintain a strong defense. By combining card draw, removal spells, and counter magic, it aims to control the tempo of the game and limit the opponent's ability to develop their own game plan. This Dimir Control deck is designed to outlast opponents and secure victory through strategic play and resource management.

The main idea of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with a mix of counterspells, removal, and hand disruption spells. The deck aims to control the game by using cards like Fatal Push, Force of Negation, and Counterspell to prevent the opponent from developing their board. Additionally, it includes powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to pressure the opponent and close out the game. The deck also utilizes card draw and filtering spells like Consider and Preordain to ensure consistency in drawing the right cards at the right time.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures that have abilities triggering when they enter the battlefield or leave it, allowing for constant blinking of creatures for value. It combines aggressive plays with disruptive elements like removal and hand disruption to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gaining incremental advantage through repeated creature blinking. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with powerful creatures and abilities while maintaining a disruptive element to control the game.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively utilize low-cost spells and creatures to deal quick and efficient damage to the opponent. The deck focuses on playing spells quickly, building up prowess triggers, and using cheap removal and burn spells to clear the way for attacks. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help to smooth out draws and maintain a consistent pace of aggression. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a focused and relentless assault while maintaining card advantage and flexibility in its strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Emperor of Bones, then using cards like Goryo's Vengeance to bring them back to the battlefield for a game-changing play. The combination of instant reanimation spells and disruptive control cards like Force of Negation make it difficult for opponents to counter your game plan. By assembling the right cards at the right time, this deck can create explosive turns that swing the game in your favor and secure a swift victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, using cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to quickly pressure the opponent. The deck also utilizes burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to deal direct damage and control the board. Additionally, cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide powerful finishers to close out games. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures, burn spells, and powerful finishers.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and utilizing direct damage spells to control the board and overwhelm the opponent. The combination of efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, along with powerful spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment, allows for a fast and relentless attack strategy. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison further disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provide additional value and resilience. Overall, this deck aims to win through swift and decisive aggression.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures and spells in order to quickly reduce their life total to zero. By utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to control the board and deal damage efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Mutagenic Growth and Violent Urge allows for additional burst damage and removal options. The deck's focus on speed and aggression makes it a formidable opponent in a 1 vs 1 matchup.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counter spells, removal spells, and versatile creatures. By utilizing powerful cards like Force of Negation and Wrath of the Skies, the player aims to disrupt their opponent's strategy and maintain board control. Additionally, the deck includes alternative win conditions such as Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Consign to Memory to close out the game. The mana base is carefully constructed to support a wide range of spells and ensure consistent access to the deck's powerful effects.

This deck focuses on a strategy that combines aggressive creatures with the ability to repeatedly exile and return them to the battlefield for added value. By using cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, the deck gains tempo and disruption against opponents while also providing a constant stream of threats. The inclusion of cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize helps to control the opponent's board while maintaining pressure with creatures like Emperor of Bones and Overlord of the Balemurk. Liliana, the Last Hope offers additional recursion and support, making this deck a versatile and powerful aggro-blink archetype.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells. It maintains control of the game by countering key spells, disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize, and removing threats with Fatal Push and Dismember. The deck also includes cards like Psychic Frog and Murktide Regent to generate card advantage and pressure the opponent. Overall, the strategy revolves around disrupting the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage and controlling the board.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of control spells and abilities to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain board control. It includes a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw effects to handle threats and maintain card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Psychic Frog, Murktide Regent, and Abhorrent Oculus allows for additional card advantage and threats, while cards like Thoughtseize and Consider provide information and manipulate both players' hands. The deck aims to outlast the opponent by controlling the game and strategically using its resources to stay ahead.
